resources.string: Psiphon chooses a protocol automatically. The CDN edges remain available for any fronted protocol selected.
Usual Psiphon protocols (SSH, OSSH, TLS, QUIC, meek), including CDN-fronted variants. Server-issued tactics are off.
All traffic uses an Akamai or Fastly edge with an innocent-looking SNI. For networks that allow only major CDNs; slower.
Psiphon runs through Aether here, so QUIC variants are skipped: a SOCKS proxy cannot carry UDP.
Blank uses built-in Akamai and Fastly edges. Separate IPv4 or CIDR entries with commas or new lines; they are checked before connecting. SNI is visible in the TLS handshake; blank uses the edge IP.
